title: ModPack Native SMP
description: Modpack Native SMP — is the most lightweight and optimized assembly for comfortable play on our server. It preserves the vanilla style, adding only the necessary tools for voice communication, animations, and stable performance with high FPS.
body:
**Modpack Native SMP** — is the official, ultimately optimized modpack based on **Fabric 1.21.11**, designed to provide the best gaming experience on our server. The assembly harmoniously combines cutting-edge technical solutions and tools for deep social interaction while maintaining the classic atmosphere of **vanilla survival**.

The primary focus of the modpack is on communication and live interaction. Thanks to the integration of **Simple Voice Chat and AudioPlayer**, positional voice chat and audio file playback are available on the server, while the **Voice Messages** mod allows for exchanging voice notes. The Emotecraft expressive animation system, powered by **PlayerAnimationLib**, makes player interaction intuitive and emotional.

The technical side of the pack features a powerful optimization stack. At its core are **Sodium and Lithium**, supplemented by **FerriteCore** for RAM efficiency and **ImmediatelyFast** for accelerated text and interface rendering. A complex of tools to limit invisible rendering — **EntityCulling** and **MoreCulling** — along with **Noxesium**, guarantees a consistently high FPS and smooth data packet transmission even in crowded locations.

For the visual component and convenience, Iris Shaders is integrated to allow the use of modern shaders, with **Reese's Sodium Options** provided for detailed configuration. Decoration enthusiasts will appreciate **ArmorPoser**, which allows for the fine-tuning of armor stands. All mod functionality is coordinated through auxiliary libraries like **Fabric API, Architectury, Cloth Config, and Placeholder API**, while mod list management is accessible directly from the game menu thanks to ModMenu.

**Modpack Native SMP** — is a lightweight, reliable, and fully "plug-and-play" solution. The pack is ideally suited for both high-end PCs and low-end systems, ensuring maximum comfort and total immersion into the life of our server community.
